summary: Equinox Gold Corp. filed a Form 6-K with its Business Acquisition Report disclosing completion of its acquisition of Orla Mining Ltd. via a court-approved plan of arrangement under the Canada Business Corporations Act, effective July 31, 2026. Equinox issued 1.00 Equinox Gold share and US$0.0001 cash per Orla share. Orla's operating mines Camino Rojo and Musselwhite and the South Railroad project were acquired. Consideration was stock-based with an exchange ratio of 1.0. The filing includes pro forma financial statements and consents from auditors Deloitte and Ernst & Young. Watch for integration execution and share price dynamics post-completion.
